what_it_does: This system speeds up two critical steps in functional safety verification for electronic hardware: Failure Mode Analysis (FMA) and Fault Injection (FI) testing. FMA identifies what can go wrong in a chip when errors occur; FI testing simulates those errors to measure impact. The work automates FMA to reduce manual work and uses GNN (Graph Neural Networks) machine learning to predict which faults are most critical, avoiding redundant simulation.
